notes.title: Bug fixes and gameplay changes
notes.notes:
This is mostly a small update to make the game easier in certain areas and fixing a small bug.
[olist]
[*] Enemy HP in multiple zones changed to be easier to defeat in the main game and the arcade mode. The first area wasn't touched, everything else was.
[*] Bug with The Bank giving a percentage lower in interest after every run's defeat. Now any money in the bank will always gives 5% in interest after each run as long as money is in it. 
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch 1 - bug fixes and changes
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug in the third area
- Changed the positioning of some UI text to be better
- Added a small scene for the upgrade explanation
- Nerfed Lava damage from 5 HP to 2 HP
